bosses.title: The Fixer

combat.gimmick: Bodyguards, turrets, and political smear attacks; retreats into a panic room when pressed.

approach: You kids crawled all the way up Cross Tower. I'm flattered — and offended.
revelation: The precincts, the permits, the payoffs — that was all me. The Flats stayed hungry because I kept the lid screwed on.
I didn't invent the Seven Sorrows. I just made sure the city looked the other way.
final_word: Spare me and I can still bury a warrant. Kill me and every camera in this tower starts screaming your names.

bosses.voice_direction: Smooth, urbane, convincing — politician cadence with a velvet threat underneath.

bosses.title: The Broker

combat.gimmick: Drones, turrets, and data scrambles behind a personal energy shield.

approach: You're interrupting a closed transaction. That costs extra.
revelation: I sold the routes, the keys, the silence. Every Sorrow had a ledger line with my signature.
Sentiment is a liability. The crew was inventory — until you stopped being profitable.
final_word: Spare the asset and I transfer clearance. Liquidate me and the vault locks for good.

bosses.voice_direction: Colder, transactional, calculating — every line sounds like a term sheet.

bosses.title: The Pusher

combat.gimmick: Chemical weapons and toxin clouds; self-injects into a Super Rager phase.

approach: Don't touch the glass. The samples are temperamental — like me.
revelation: I didn't poison the Flats for fun. I perfected a formula. Your people were the proof of concept.
Every overdose, every shaking hand — that was data. Beautiful, screaming data.
final_word: Kill the doctor and the cure dies with her. Spare me and I'll tell you which batch still walks the streets.

bosses.voice_direction: Unhinged, self-convinced, proud — scientist ecstasy tipping into mania.

bosses.title: The Warden

combat.gimmick: Guards, turrets, and gas waves; closes distance with riot shield and baton.

approach: On the ground. Hands where I can see them. This is still my house.
revelation: I locked up whoever the Six pointed at. Your people got buried under paperwork and broken ribs.
Order ain't pretty. Somebody has to hold the line while the city pretends it's clean.
final_word: Execute me and every guard on payroll goes loud. Spare me and I open the south wing — quiet.

bosses.voice_direction: Gravelly, military, commanding — bark-first authority that never asks twice.

bosses.title: The Trader

combat.gimmick: Digital defenses and firewall drones; reveals a mech suit for the last phase.

approach: Cute infiltration. You're still running my firmware.
revelation: I sold your faces, your routes, your heartbeats. The Sorrows were just another product launch.
You think revenge is justice? I think it's a bad quarterly.
final_word: Spare the genius and I wipe the warrants. Flatten me and every feed in the city loops your kill cam.

bosses.voice_direction: Young, arrogant, dismissive — tech-bro swagger with a cruel laugh.

bosses.title: The Priest

combat.gimmick: Deacons, traps, and fake divine illusions; rooftop flee into car chase, then final stand at the estate.

approach: Well, well. Look who finally found their way up here.
I've been expecting the Emperor's dogs. Didn't think you'd make it this far.
revelation: You're tougher than I expected. But you ain't gonna stop what's coming.

bosses.voice_direction: Deep, measured, priest-like cadence — casual menace that cracks when the flee hits.

bosses.title: The Emperor

combat.gimmick: Non-combat reckoning. Dies confessing he traded the Seven Sorrows to save the crew.

revelation: I made a deal with The Corrupted Six to save your lives.
I thought if I gave them the jobs, they'd let you walk. I was wrong.
final_word: The Flats ain't about who's right — it's about who's still standing.

bosses.voice_direction: Elder statesman in defeat — gravitas and vulnerability; confession, not a plea.
